name: cavemio-password-input
title: Password input
description: A password field with an eye that turns into eye-off, a four-step strength meter that fills and names itself, and a Caps Lock warning.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Shares field.tsx with every text control: one surface, one focus ring, one way of showing hints and errors.
- The meter is announced politely as it changes; the eye is a toggle button with aria-pressed.
- scorePassword is exported if you want the same score elsewhere.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: strength
props.description: false · Show the meter; pass a function to score it yourself.

props.name: shown / defaultShown / onShownChange
props.description: — / false · Whether the password shows as text, controlled or not; onShownChange fires when the eye is pressed.

props.name: ...Input props
props.description: – · label, hint, error, size, onValueChange and every native prop.

useCases.title: Sign-in forms

useCases.title: Sign-up and reset

features.title: Peek without losing your place
features.description: The toggle never takes focus, so the caret and the phone keyboard stay.

features.title: A meter that fills
features.description: Four segments fill left to right with a 50ms stagger; the word morphs through TextMorph.

features.title: Bring your own scoring
features.description: Pass a function (zxcvbn, your API) instead of the built-in length-and-variety score.

features.title: Caps Lock note
features.description: Read from the key events; it folds in under the field and away on blur.

states.title: hidden
states.description: Dots, with the eye at the end.

states.title: shown
states.description: The eye turns into eye-off (rotate morph, 480ms); focus stays in the field.

states.title: strength
states.description: Segments fill (420ms each, 50ms apart) and turn red, amber or green; the word morphs.

states.title: caps lock
states.description: "Caps Lock is on" folds in where the hint goes.
